myapp.Models.our_data.confirm_no_duplicate_kyc(borrower_identity)[source]¶

Confirms that a user does not belong to the same corporate twice.

Given a borrower identity fetch the borrowers detail from the KycData table. Check if the corporate trying to register the borrower has already registered the borrower if so return False and return True otherwise.
